profile.summary: A nonprofit that runs a summer music camp for young musicians ages 10 to 18 on 33 acres in Sonoma County, California. It offers instruction in orchestra, concert band, jazz ensemble, piano and guitar. It also runs JumpStart in Music, a weekend retreat program for school groups.
